title: cursor/plugins
lede: cursor/plugins holds the Cursor plugin specification and the official plugins built on it, from agent workflow tools to connectors for dozens of SaaS products.

points: Each plugin is a standalone directory at the repository root with its own .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
Developer tools include Thermos for deep branch review, Orchestrate for fanning large tasks across cloud agents, and Advisor for consulting a stronger model before big decisions.
Integrations cover Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce, HubSpot, Playwright, Ahrefs and many more business apps.
A create-plugin plugin scaffolds and validates new agent plugins against the spec.
Some plugins come from individual authors, such as Lauren Tan's pstack workflows and a continual-learning plugin that updates AGENTS.md from transcripts.

points.text: The X plugin reportedly does not work at all, the most-discussed open issue.
The GitHub plugin's Authenticate button gives no sign-in link.
